summary.method: diff = atlas height_m (LN02) - swissALTI3D 2 m bilinear terrain (LN02) at atlas lv95_e/lv95_n
summary.note: swissALTI3D is bare-earth terrain: edges on bridges, in underground stations (e.g. RBS Bern) or on raised platforms differ by design. 'inside_building' and 'near_structure' flag such cases.
